subject: LockBox Health — SOC 2 kickoff, demo request, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@lockboxhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lockboxhealth.com>, John Doe <john.doe@lockboxhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 kickoff + quick demo of audit log features

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the intro from our buyer. We're starting our SOC 2 onboarding and would like a short security intake call to: 1) run through the CAIQ/SIG high-level mapping, 2) see a live demo of audit/logging and data retention controls, and 3) confirm what artifacts you can provide (logs, process docs, config screenshots).

Possible times this week: Tue 11/30 10–11am PT or Wed 12/1 2–3pm PT. If those don't work, we'll propose alternatives.

For context: we'll need an example of exported audit logs covering API keys and admin role changes, and an architecture diagram that we can include in our SOC 2 evidence pack.

Best,
Ethan Morales
Head of Security
LockBox Health

---

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@lockboxhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lockboxhealth.com>, John Doe <john.doe@lockboxhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 kickoff + quick demo of audit log features

Hi Ethan — great to meet you (virtually). Tue 11/30 10–11am PT works for our team. I'm looping in Marissa (Security Intake) and Ben (Solutions) so we can cover CAIQ expectations and log samples.

Agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick intros + scope
- Audit/logging demo (retention, filtering, export)
- CAIQ/SIG mapping overview and what evidence we can provide
- Action items and delivery cadence

Requested artifacts we can prepare ahead:
- Example audit log export (redwood-audit-log-sample.csv)
- Network/infra diagram (redwood-network-diagram.pdf)
- SOC 2 control matrix (summary doc) — Marissa will confirm availability

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 11/30 10:00 PT. If you prefer Wed, let me know and we'll switch.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Security PM
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood-audit-log-sample.csv (CSV, 14 KB); redwood-network-diagram.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@lockboxhealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@lockboxhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 kickoff + quick demo of audit log features

Thanks Sofia — I'll own the CAIQ/SIG mapping discussion. A couple notes for the call so we can be efficient:
- Will LockBox want a full CAIQ prefilled or just a prioritized subset?
- Typical deliverables we can provide post-call: control narrative snippets, screenshots of config (IAM, VPC), auditor-friendly export of logs (CSV) and log retention policy text.
- For network diagram: we can provide a redacted infra diagram that shows VPC boundaries and ingress/egress controls; if you need full cloud account ids we may need an NDA addendum — clarify on the call.

I'll also prepare a short matrix linking common SIG questions to the artifacts we'll provide and mark anything that requires broader engineering input.

Marissa
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@lockboxhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lockboxhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 kickoff + quick demo of audit log features

Quick note ahead of the call — on the audit logs we'll show:
- How we capture API key events, admin role changes, dataset access events, and model deployment events
- Filtering by timeframe and user id (sample export will cover a 7-day window)
- Retention buckets: 90 days hot, 365 days cold, 7 years archive (per customer contract options)

Action items for call:
1) Confirm sample time range and fields you'd like in CSV (Ethan)
2) Confirm whether you need MD5 checksums or signed export for chain-of-custody
3) Identify any additional redactions required before we share diagrams

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@lockboxhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lockboxhealth.com>, John Doe <john.doe@lockboxhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 kickoff + quick demo of audit log features

Appreciate the prep — Tue 10am worked well, thanks for the demo and answers. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 
- Confirmed we need the 7-day CSV sample with fields: timestamp, event_type, actor_id, resource, action, ip_address, request_id
- LockBox prefers signed export; can you provide a hash (SHA256) with the CSV?
- We'll accept the redacted network diagram and the control narrative snippets that map to SIG questions.
- Follow-up: please send artifacts by EOD Friday 12/04 if possible.

Outstanding:
- Any PII redaction in logs — confirm what you redact vs what you provide (Ben to confirm)
- CAIQ specific items that require product engineering signoff (Marissa will flag)

Thanks — looking forward to the packet.

Best,
Ethan
Head of Security, LockBox Health

Attachment references (provided during call): redwood-audit-log-sample.csv, redwood-network-diagram.pdf
